title: Sparkly planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planetGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7dd3fc'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#3b82f6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1e40af'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fbbf24'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#f59e0b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d97706'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringGrad2' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fde68a'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#fcd34d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fbbf24'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Back ring (behind planet) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad2)' stroke-width='5' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-20 50 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.6' transform='rotate(-20 50 52)'/>

  <!-- Planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='26' fill='url(#planetGrad)'/>

  <!-- Planet highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='40' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#bae6fd' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- Planet bands/stripes -->
  <path d='M28 44 Q50 39 72 44' fill='none' stroke='#60a5fa' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M27 52 Q50 47 73 52' fill='none' stroke='#2563eb' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M30 59 Q50 55 70 59' fill='none' stroke='#60a5fa' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Front ring (in front of planet) -->
  <path d='M6 52 Q6 62 50 62 Q94 62 94 52' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='5' transform='rotate(-20 50 52)'/>
  <path d='M6 52 Q6 62 50 62 Q94 62 94 52' fill='none' stroke='#fde68a' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-20 50 52)'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Sparkle 1 - top left -->
  <g transform='translate(18 20)'>
    <path d='M0 -5 L1.2 -1.2 L5 0 L1.2 1.2 L0 5 L-1.2 1.2 L-5 0 L-1.2 -1.2 Z' fill='#fef08a'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 - top right -->
  <g transform='translate(82 18)'>
    <path d='M0 -6 L1.5 -1.5 L6 0 L1.5 1.5 L0 6 L-1.5 1.5 L-6 0 L-1.5 -1.5 Z' fill='#fef9c3'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 - bottom left -->
  <g transform='translate(14 78)'>
    <path d='M0 -4 L1 -1 L4 0 L1 1 L0 4 L-1 1 L-4 0 L-1 -1 Z' fill='#fde047'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 4 - bottom right -->
  <g transform='translate(84 82)'>
    <path d='M0 -5 L1.2 -1.2 L5 0 L1.2 1.2 L0 5 L-1.2 1.2 L-5 0 L-1.2 -1.2 Z' fill='#fef08a'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 5 - small top center -->
  <g transform='translate(50 12)'>
    <path d='M0 -3 L0.8 -0.8 L3 0 L0.8 0.8 L0 3 L-0.8 0.8 L-3 0 L-0.8 -0.8 Z' fill='#fef9c3'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 6 - right side -->
  <g transform='translate(92 48)'>
    <path d='M0 -3.5 L0.9 -0.9 L3.5 0 L0.9 0.9 L0 3.5 L-0.9 0.9 L-3.5 0 L-0.9 -0.9 Z' fill='#fde047'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 7 - left side -->
  <g transform='translate(6 50)'>
    <path d='M0 -3 L0.8 -0.8 L3 0 L0.8 0.8 L0 3 L-0.8 0.8 L-3 0 L-0.8 -0.8 Z' fill='#fef08a'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small dots for sparkle dust -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='15' r='1.2' fill='#fef9c3' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='12' r='1' fill='#fde047' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='68' r='1.2' fill='#fef08a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='65' r='1' fill='#fef9c3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='85' r='1.2' fill='#fde047' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='88' r='1' fill='#fef08a' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
